Summary: Durable canonical relationship store and temporal interpretation on it (decision record step 4)
Description: 1) Original intent: Decision Record 2026-10-11 section 2 (canonical relationships are durable and versioned: entity-scoped, time-stamped, evidence-linked) and step 4 (stand up the durable store and migrate temporal interpretation onto it), so formation, temporal interpretation and synthesis share one substrate and a subject analysed once is not rebuilt from scratch next time. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) append-only versioned storage of canonical relationships with stable relationship ids across sessions (immutable versions, idempotent on the same evidence, nothing updated or deleted); (b) the single write path (admitAndProject) writes through; a subject's stored relationships are restored into the in-memory store before the SEC lookups so re-admission is PERSISTENT and the first view already holds earlier work; (c) analytical snapshot records (lookups, frozen relationship set, pinned temporal result) are stored; (d) counterparty registrant search results are cached with retrieval time; (e) PostgreSQL first with a file fallback; an unreachable database never stalls a read or a write (capped queries, circuit breaker) and the file fallback is first-class; (f) the temporal comparison reads its observations from the store (history of 13D/13G observations as relationship versions), retrieves only what is newer than the stored retrieval record, still classifies with the KRYL-1386 rules unchanged, and falls back to stored history with incomplete coverage when SEC is unreachable; (g) the classification result for a subject is the same whether built from a full retrieval or from stored history plus an increment; (h) two entities, one registry-resolved and one admitted at runtime; existing suites green; benchmark baseline untouched. 3) Current implementation state: step 4a built (a1fdc92): server module as-diff/canonicalstore.js, routes /v1/canonical-store, client canonicalstoreclient.js, write-through sink, hydrate, snapshot persistence, registrant cache; tests qa_canonicalstore 19/19; live two-entity run with a populated store. Step 4b (temporal on the store) in progress. Fact to know: the database is unreachable on the development machine (ECONNREFUSED) and the engine's own code notes it was unreachable from the VPS on 2026-10-03, so the file fallback is the effective store today. 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1398 (snapshot), KRYL-1401 (admission), KRYL-1386 (temporal rules, unchanged), decision record sections 2 and 4. Production exposure needs a web-server location block for /v1/canonical-store and the Founder's explicit go; not part of this ticket and not done. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (durable canonical substrate; History consumes it in a later step). Status: opened 2026-10-11.
